upgradeAttempt.cause: upgrader bug: the restore drill compared per-table row counts in the order PostgreSQL listed the tables, and on the pilot (146 tables) the restored copy was listed in a different order, so equal counts were reported as different. No data was lost or changed; the backup itself was fine
upgradeAttempt.secondBug: upgrader bug: after the drill failed, the upgrader left the pilot stopped instead of restarting 0.1.48
upgradeAttempt.recovery: the operator restarted the 0.1.48 runtime by hand; 0.1.48 then ran unchanged until the 0.1.50 upgrade
upgradeAttempt.fixedIn: 0.1.50 (#196): the drill compares row counts table by table regardless of order and names the tables that really differ; any failure after the pilot is stopped (backup, drill, start or health) restarts the previous runtime and reports why.
